title: Vercel Connect now accepts service submissions
summary: Vercel Connect now lets you submit your own service to the connectors directory , so you no longer need to wait for Vercel to build a connector for it. Submitting a service takes four steps: Describe your service. Add one or more connection methods, using OAuth or an API key. Verify each OAuth method by requesting a real token through a test connector. Send the submission for review. Vercel reviews each submission before publishing it to the directory.
